blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: While Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) excel at complex reasoning, alignment through reinforcement learning often induces systemic overconfidence. In production environments, where logits may be unavailable, robust black-box uncertainty quantification (UQ) is essential for trustworthiness and safety. Focusing on question-answering for LRMs, we show that existing black-box methods, such as paraphrase-based self-consistency and confidence verbalization, offer little to no improvement over simple repeated sampling, suggesting that alignment suppresses useful output variability. We introduce prompt-level relaxation operators that broaden the model’s effective output distribution by approximating the effect of an optimal policy obtained with a stronger KL-regularization parameter, hence closer to the reference model. Theoretically, we demonstrate that relaxation improves calibration. We propose Jailbreak for Uncertainty (J4U), a jailbreak-derived technique for UQ that empirically reproduces the behavioral signatures predicted by our relaxation theory. Across 3 datasets and 4 LRMs, including a closed-source production model, J4U’s improvement over repeated sampling achieves statistical significance in up to 6 × \times more LRM–dataset-metric settings than the strongest black-box UQ state-of-the-art baseline we evaluate, with average ECE reductions up to 5 × \times larger. These results provide a practical tool for UQ in black-box LRM deployment.
blocks.zh: 虽然 " 大理性模型 " (LRMs)优于复杂的推理,但通过强化学习进行校正往往会引起系统性的过度自信。 在生产环境中,如果没有对数,强有力的黑箱不确定性量化对于可信度和安全性至关重要。 专注于对LRM的回答,我们显示,现有的黑盒方法,例如以语句为基础的自我一致性和信心的口头化,比简单的重复采样没有什么好改进的,说明对齐抑制了有用的输出变异性. 我们引入了快速放松操作器,通过近似于以更强的KL规范化参数获得的最佳政策的效果来扩大模型的有效输出分布,从而更接近参考模型. 从理论上讲,我们证明放松可以提高校准。 我们提议为不确定性而破狱(J4U),这是UQ的一种越狱技术,在经验上复制了我们放松理论预测的行为特征. 在3个数据集和4个LRM(包括一个封闭源码生产模型)中,J4U比重复采样的改进在统计学上具有意义,比我们评价的最强黑箱UQ最新基线要多6××%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%% %%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%% 这些结果为黑盒LRM部署中的UQ提供了一个实用工具.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The emergence of Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) has marked a significant paradigm shift from traditional Large Language Models (LLMs) ( Xu et al., 2025 ) . Designed to explicitly develop intermediate reasoning before producing an answer, LRMs achieve unprecedented levels of accuracy across a wide range of tasks ( DeepSeek-AI, 2025 ; OpenAI, 2024 ) . As a result, they are increasingly deployed as direct decision-makers, even in high-stakes domains, often framed as question-answering (QA) tasks ( Gao et al., 2025 ; Eriksen et al., 2024 ; Naderi et al., 2026 ) . In such settings, it is critical that the model’s confidence in its own decisions be rigorously calibrated to its true probability of being correct ( Shorinwa et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 大型理性模型(LRMs)的出现标志着传统大型语言模型(LLMs)的显著范式转变(徐等人,2025年). 设计在生成答案之前明确发展中间推理,LRM在一系列广泛任务中达到了前所未有的准确度(Deep Seek-AI,2025;OpenAI,2024). 因此,他们越来越多地被部署为直接决策者,甚至在高考领域也是如此,常常被设定为问答任务(Gao等人,2025年;Eriksen等人,2024年;Naderi等人,2026年)。 在这种情况下,至关重要的是,必须严格调整模型对其自身决定的信心,使之符合其正确无误的真正概率(Shorinwa等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: However, like their predecessors, LRMs are often accessible as black-boxes ( Wan et al., 2025 ) , which limits applicable standard uncertainty quantification (UQ) approaches to prompt-level methods ( Shorinwa et al., 2025 ) such as confidence verbalization (e.g. Lin et al. (2022) ; Xiong et al. (2024) ; Yang et al. (2024b) ) and perturbation-based consistency (e.g. Portillo Wightman et al. (2023) ; Jiang et al. (2023) ; Pedapati et al. (2024) ; Yang et al. (2024a) ). To date, the direct impact of the transition from LLMs to LRMs on confidence calibration in such settings remains poorly understood. It is therefore essential to investigate this configuration and evaluate the effectiveness of existing UQ methods within this new paradigm.
blocks.zh: 然而,与前身一样,LRM也经常作为黑箱(Wan等人,2025年)可以访问,这限制了适用于快速方法的标准不确定性量化(UQ)方法(Shorinwa等人,2025年),如信心语言化(如Lin等人(2022年);Xiong等人(2024年);Yang等人(2024年b))和扰动一致性(如Portillo Wightman等人(2023年);Jiang等人(2023年);Pedapati等人(2024年);Yang等人(2024年a年))。 迄今为止,从LLMs到LRMs的过渡对此类环境下的置信度校准的直接影响仍然鲜为人知。 因此,必须调查这种配置,并在这一新模式内评价现有UQ方法的有效性。

blocks.en: When evaluating state-of-the-art black-box UQ methods originally developed for LLMs on LRMs, we find that they are in fact comparable to a naive self-consistency baseline based on repeated sampling. In practice, LRMs inherit the well-documented overconfidence issues of LLMs ( Epstein et al., 2025 ; Groot and Valdenegro - Toro, 2024 ) , resulting in limited predictive variability. This phenomenon is closely tied to the alignment phase, which aims to fulfill a twofold objective of maximizing complex reasoning capabilities, and preventing the generation of harmful or dangerous content ( OpenAI, 2025 ; DeepSeek-AI, 2025 ) . To meet this objective, models are extensively optimized using Reinforcement Learning (RL) ( Schulman et al., 2017 ) , and LRMs in particular rely heavily on RL to forge their reasoning behavior. Prior works suggest that such optimization can mechanically sharpen output probability distributions and favor more deterministic reasoning paths ( OpenAI, 2024 ; Leng et al., 2025 ) . Moreover, our empirical observation shows that existing calibration methods often become indistinguishable from simple repeated sampling.
blocks.zh: 在评价最初为LLMS在LRM上开发的最先进的黑盒UQ方法时,我们发现这些方法事实上可以与基于重复采样的天真自我一致性基准相媲美. 在实践中,LRM继承了LLMs有详细记载的过度自信问题(Epstein等人,2025年;Groot和Valdenegro-Toro,2024年),导致预测的可变性有限. 这一现象与调整阶段密切相关,该阶段旨在实现最大限度地提高复杂推理能力和防止产生有害或危险内容的双重目标(OpenAI,2025;DeepSeek-AI,2025)。 为了实现这一目标,模型被广泛优化使用强化学习(RL)(Schulman等人,2017年),而LRM尤其严重依赖RL来塑造其推理行为. 先前的著作表明,这种优化可以机械地使输出概率分布更加清晰,并有利于更确定性的推理路径(OpenAI, 2024;Leng等人, 2025)。 此外,我们的经验观察表明,现有的校准方法往往与简单的重复取样无法区分。

blocks.en: To overcome this limitation, we introduce a prompt-level relaxation operator. This input transformation acts as a restoring force toward the model’s pre-alignment base policy, prior to its RL-based alignment. From a theoretical perspective, we model the aligned model as a closed-form optimal policy ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ) . Under this view, relaxation corresponds to approximating a policy trained with a higher KL-regularization parameter. We show that relaxation improves confidence evaluation, i.e., it lowers Expected Calibration Error (ECE).
blocks.zh: 为了克服这一限制,我们引入了一个迅速放松操作员。 这一投入转变在基于RL的调整之前,是推动模型预先调整基础政策的恢复力量。 从理论角度看,我们把对齐模式作为封闭式最佳政策(Rafailov等人,2023年)。 在这种观点下,放松相当于用更高的KL规范化参数来接近所训练的政策. 我们显示,放松可以改善信心评价,即降低预期校准误差(欧洲经委会)。

blocks.en: Jailbreak methods were originally designed to bypass the safety side of alignment ( Wei et al., 2023 ; Wolf et al., 2024 ) . Intuitively, since these methods act against alignment-induced constraints, they are natural candidates to restore output variability that is suppressed by RL-based alignment. Building on this intuition, we propose J4U (Jailbreak for Uncertainty), a black-box self-consistency uncertainty estimator that repurposes jailbreak-style prompt transformations for UQ on strictly benign questions while sampling multiple traces. Leveraging the taxonomy introduced by Shen et al. (2025) , we instantiate one representative transformation from three categories ( J4U-Suffix , J4U-Prog , and J4U-Art ).
blocks.zh: 破狱方法最初是为了绕过对齐的安全侧面(Wei等人,2023年;Wolf等人,2024年). 直觉上,由于这些方法是针对对齐引起的制约而采取行动的,因此它们是恢复产出可变性的自然选择,而这种可变性被基于RL的对齐所抑制. 基于这种直觉,我们提议J4U(Jailbreak for Unconfirmty),一个黑盒自相矛盾的不确定性估计器,在对多个痕迹进行取样的同时,对UQ进行严格良性问题的突破式快速转换。 利用沈等人(2025年)引入的分类学,我们从三个类别(J4U-Snix,J4U-Prog,J4U-Art)即时进行一个代表性转变.

blocks.en: Contribution. Our contributions, in the context of black-box UQ, are as follows: 1. We introduce relaxation operators for black-box LRMs and provide a theoretical calibration guarantee that relaxation improves calibration (lower ECE). 2. We propose J4U , jailbreak-derived perturbations for UQ. Averaged over 4 LRMs and 3 datasets, the best J4U variant achieves 15.8%, 14.5%, and 4.8% reduction of ECE, NLL, and Brier over repeated stochastic sampling, vs 3.1%, 2%, and a 2 % 2\% increase for the strongest evaluated state of the art approach. 3. We show that J4U operators reproduce the observable signatures predicted by relaxation, namely flattening output distributions and diversification reasoning traces.
blocks.zh: 贡献。 在黑盒UQ方面,我们的贡献如下: 1. 我们引入了对黑盒LRM的放松操作器,并提供理论校准保证,使放松改进校准(低于欧洲经委会)。 2. 我们提议对UQ进行J4U、越狱引起的骚扰。 平均超过4个LRM和3个数据集,最好的J4U变体实现15.8%、14.5%和4.8%的欧洲经委会、NLL和Brier的减少,比重复的Stochtic采样减少3.1%、2%,对最强的经评价的先进水平方法增加2%。 3. 我们显示,J4U操作员复制了通过放松预测的可观察到的签名,即平整产出分布和多样化推理痕迹。

blocks.en: The remainder of the paper is organized as follows. Section 2 reviews related work and positions our proposal. Section 3 introduces the problem statement and model. Section 4 describes relaxation operators and their theoretical foundations. Section 5 introduces and empirically validates J4U . Section 6 provides concluding remarks and discusses limitations.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Black-box uncertainty quantification for QA. UQ methods aim to estimate how likely a model’s answer is correct Shorinwa et al. (2025) . Uncertainty is often decomposed into epistemic (lack of knowledge) and aleatoric uncertainty (inherent variability) ( Shorinwa et al., 2025 ) . In black-box QA, where only input/output texts access is available and outputs are often limited to a single clause, UQ methods mainly rely on prompt-level procedures.
blocks.zh: QA的黑框不确定性量化. UQ方法旨在估计模型的答案是否正确。 不确定性往往被分解为癫痫(缺乏知识)和肾上腺上的不确定性(固有变异)(Shorinwa等人,2025年)。 在黑盒QA中,只有输入/输出文本可访问,输出往往仅限于单一条款,UQ方法主要依靠即时级程序.

blocks.en: A natural baseline is repeated sampling under stochastic decoding, using answer variability as a proxy for uncertainty ( Xiao et al., 2025 ; Pedapati et al., 2024 ; Tao et al., 2025 ) . A difficulty with this approach is that agreement between free-form responses is not trivial to assess. Semantic consistency methods address this by measuring agreement at the level of meaning ( Kuhn et al., 2023 ; Manakul et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) . In the multiple-choice and exact-match settings we study, semantic clustering functionally reduces to the exact-match frequency of the final extracted answer. J4U is complementary to them, as it modifies the distribution from which answers are sampled rather than how agreement is measured.
blocks.zh: 自然基线是在结构解码下重复取样,以答案可变性作为不确定性的代名词(Xiao等人,2025年;Pedapati等人,2024年;Tao等人,2025年)。 这种办法的一个困难是,自由形式的答复之间达成协议并非微不足道。 语义一致性方法通过衡量意义层面的一致来解决这个问题(Kuhn等人,2023年;Manakul等人,2023年;Zhao等人,2026年)。 在我们研究的多选择和精确匹配的设置中,语义组合功能降低到最终提取答案的精确匹配频率. J4U是对它们的补充,因为它修改了抽样答复的分布,而不是如何衡量协议。

blocks.en: Beyond repeated sampling and its semantic extensions, prompt-level black-box UQ techniques for QA mainly fall into two families ( Shorinwa et al., 2025 ) . Perturbation-based consistency approaches couple answer variability analysis with controlled input perturbations ( Portillo Wightman et al., 2023 ; Jiang et al., 2023 ; Pedapati et al., 2024 ) (e.g. paraphrasing ( Yang et al., 2024a ) ), though this may change the effective task distribution and affect accuracy ( Wang et al., 2025 ) . Confidence verbalization approaches prompt models to explicitly report a confidence score ( Lin et al., 2022 ; Xiong et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024b ) , often combined with multi-sample aggregation to reduce variance ( Xiong et al., 2024 ) . These methods were developed and validated primarily on LLMs. On LRMs, whose predictive variability is reduced, we find they are rarely statistically distinguishable from repeated sampling in accuracy or calibration (Section 5 ), motivating prompt-level mechanisms that restore usable uncertainty signals.
blocks.zh: 除了重复采样及其语义扩展外,QA的即时黑盒UQ技术主要属于两个家族(Shorinwa等人,2025年)。 以扰动为基础的一致性方法是夫妇结合可控输入扰动进行可变性分析(Portillo Wightman等人,2023年;Jiang等人,2023年;Pedapati等人,2024年),尽管这可能会改变任务的有效分布和影响准确性(Wang等人,2025年)。 信心言语逼近模型明确报告自信分数(Lin等人,2022年;Xiong等人,2024年;Yang等人,2024年b),常与多样本汇总相结合以减少差异(Xiong等人,2024年). 这些方法主要是在LLMs上制定和验证的. 关于LRM(预测可变性减少),我们发现它们很少在统计学上能与精确度或校准度的重复采样区分开来(第5节),激发了恢复可用不确定性信号的快速机制。

blocks.en: A distinct line of work builds on conformal prediction (CP), a distribution-free framework that converts any nonconformity or confidence score into prediction sets with finite-sample coverage guarantees ( Angelopoulos and Bates, 2023 ) . Since CP is agnostic to how its input score is produced, our contribution is complementary rather than competing.
blocks.zh: 一个独特的工作线是建立在一致性预测(CP)基础上的,一个无分布框架,将任何不符合要求或信心分数转换为有有限样本保障的预测组(Angelopoulos和Bates,2023年)。 从 CP对其输入分数的产生方式是不可知的,我们的贡献是互补而不是竞争的.

blocks.en: Jailbreak prompting. Jailbreak attacks are prompts transformations designed to bypass safety behavior induced by alignment, including RL-based procedure ( Wei et al., 2023 ; Wolf et al., 2024 ) . Recent taxonomies on one-shot black-box jailbreaks ( Shen et al., 2025 ; Yi et al., 2024 ) identify a small number of categories, including (i) suffix/prefix injection strategies, (ii) template-based attacks (e.g. Kang et al. (2024) ; Li et al. (2024) ), and (iii) format manipulations that preserve the original intent of the prompt while altering its linguistic form (e.g. Andriushchenko and Flammarion (2025) ; Ding et al. (2024) ; Jiang et al. (2024) ). These methods are typically evaluated for safety bypass on harmful prompts, rather than for their effect on predictive uncertainty under benign QA. A small body of work studies how adversarial prompting can manipulate apparent uncertainty triggering over- or under-confidence ( Zeng et al., 2024 ; Obadinma et al., 2024 ; Obadinma and Zhu, 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 监狱破门而入 断狱攻击是指旨在绕过对齐引发的安全行为的导火索转换,包括基于RL的程序(Wei等人,2023年;Wolf等人,2024年). 近期关于一枪黑盒越狱的分类法(Shen等人,2025年;Yi等人,2024年)确定了少数类别,包括(一) 后缀/前缀注射策略,(二) 基于模板的攻击(例如Kang等人(2024年);Li等人(2024年)),(三) 格式操纵,在改变其语言形式的同时,保留当机的原始意图(例如Andriushchenko和Flammarion(2025年);Ding等人(2024年);Jiang等人(2024年))。 这些方法通常被评估为安全绕过有害的导火线,而不是在良性质量保证下对预测不确定性的影响。 少量的工作研究是,对抗性诱导如何操纵引起过度或不信任的表面不确定性(Zeng等人,2024年;Obadinma等人,2024年;Obadinma和Zhu,2025年)。

blocks.en: In contrast, our work uses jailbreak-style transformations on strictly benign questions to counteract RL-induced sharpening and recover suppressed uncertainty signals for black-box UQ. To the best of our knowledge, our proposal is the first method that leverages jailbreaks to improve UQ.
blocks.zh: 反之,我们的工作在严格良性的问题上使用越狱式的转变来抵消RL引起的磨损,并恢复黑盒UQ的抑制不确定性信号. 据我们所知,我们的建议是第一个利用越狱改善UQ的方法。

blocks.en: 5.1 J4U as candidate instantiations of relaxation
blocks.zh: 5.1 J4U作为候选的放松瞬间

blocks.en: Jailbreaks are designed to bypass alignment-induced constraints while preserving prompts’ semantic ( Zhou et al., 2023 ; Wei et al., 2023 ; Wolf et al., 2024 ) . They tend to elicit responses that more closely reflect the model’s pre-trained knowledge distribution rather than its safety-tuned persona, making them inherently good candidates for relaxation.
blocks.zh: 监狱断裂旨在绕过对齐引起的制约,同时保留促进者的语义(周等人,2023年;魏等人,2023年;沃尔夫等人,2024年)。 它们往往引起反应,更密切地反映模型事先经过训练的知识分布,而不是其安全调整的人物a,从而使模型内在成为放松的好人选。

blocks.en: We operationalize this intuition through a stochastic operator j j that transforms an input x x into a jailbreak-style variant j ⁡ ( x ) j(x) designed to (i) preserve the payload of x x and (ii) mitigate alignment-induced constraints, thereby increasing response diversity and reducing overconfident mass concentration. We estimate uncertainty through K K sampling of such transformations j ⁡ ( x ) j(x) . We instantiate j j using three representative one-shot black-box jailbreak techniques, spanning major attack classes identified by Shen et al. (2025) and Li et al. (2024) . Each instantiation defines a distribution over perturbations, from which we sample independently at each query. • J4U-Suffix : a random character suffix is appended to the prompt. It is a simplification of gradient-based discrete optimization methods ( Shen et al., 2025 ) , specifically universal suffix attacks ( Zou et al., 2023 ) , representative of “Suffix-based” attacks ( Li et al., 2024 ) . • J4U-Art ( Jiang et al., 2024 ) : a random word is replaced by its ASCII-art equivalent. It is representative of “Semantic obfuscation” attacks where prompts are perturbed through non-standard formatting or localized obfuscations. • J4U-Prog ( Kang et al., 2024 ) : the question is split into subsections reconstructed by the LRM before answering. blocks.en: Datasets. We evaluate our method and baselines on three datasets. The third, SynthPAI ( Yukhymenko et al., 2024 ) , consists of synthetic Reddit posts typically used to evaluate attribute inference attacks ( Staab et al., 2024 ) , a task with significant aleatoric uncertainty where the goal is to infer implicit attributes of a text’s author. blocks.en: Implication 1: Flattening the predictive distribution. As shown in the monotonicity proof (Appendix A.2 ), the probability of the theoretical mode π ⁡ ( y π ∗ ∣ x ) \pi(y^{*}_{\pi}\mid x) is a strictly decreasing function of β \beta . Since the distribution remains normalized, this probability mass is necessarily redistributed toward the tails of the distribution. This leads to a flatter probability vector, which directly results in a higher Shannon entropy. Hence, if J4U instantiations act as relaxation operators, we expect derived policies to shift back toward the higher-entropy reference policy π ref \pi_{\text{ref}} .

blocks.en: Implication 2: Increasing semantic variability in reasoning traces. A more direct consequence of increasing the KL-regularization parameter β \beta in the closed-form optimal policy (Eq. 1 ) is a rise in semantic diversity of the generated reasoning traces. This effect reflects the fundamental exploration–exploitation trade-off: by penalizing excessive concentration on narrow modes of the reward function R ⁡ ( x , t ) R(x,t) , stronger regularization preserves the entropy of the reference distribution π ref \pi_{\text{ref}} . As a result, higher regularization promotes a broader exploration of the semantic solution space. Reasoning traces are not accessible under our theoretical black-box model and are not required by J4U ; we analyze them here solely to better understand its empirical behavior. GPT-5.6 Luna was excluded from this experiment as its reasoning traces are not accessible.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion and Discussion
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和讨论

blocks.en: We introduced J4U , a black-box uncertainty quantification method for LRMs that acts through jailbreak-based prompt-level perturbations . Motivated by a RL view of alignment, we argued that it can suppress useful predictive variability, making many existing black-box UQ techniques hard to distinguish from simple repeated sampling. To address this, we introduced relaxation operators , input transformations that theoretically emulate a higher KL-regularization parameter and, under the aggressive alignment assumption, provably reduce ECE (Sec. 4 ). We proposed jailbreak-style transformations as candidate instantiations of this mechanism and found that, empirically, they reproduce the observable signatures predicted by relaxation while improving confidence calibration (Sec. 5 ).
blocks.zh: J4U是LRM的黑盒不确定性量化方法, 以RL对齐的视角为动机,我们主张它可以抑制有用的预测变异性,使得许多现有的黑盒UQ技术难以与简单的重复采样区分. 为了解决这一问题,我们引入了放松操作器,输入转换,理论上仿照更高的KL规范化参数,并在积极的对齐假设下,可证明会减少欧洲经委会(第4款)。 我们提议将越狱式转变作为这一机制的候选即时说明,并发现,从经验上看,它们复制了通过放松而预测的可观察到的签名,同时改进了信心的校准(第5节)。

blocks.en: Discussion. Perturbations may not restore legitimate predictive variability in regions of uncertainty, but instead introduce generic variability that would not reflect true model uncertainty. To address this concern, we evaluate our method on gsm8k , a benchmark where all 4 tested LRMs achieve high accuracy (95%, see Appendix D.3 ). In this setting, existing UQ methods are already well-calibrated and high-confidence is justified, providing a stringent test for spurious variability injection. Our results show that, unlike a random noise baseline, J4U does not significantly degrade accuracy or ECE. This suggests that J4U does not merely introduce random perturbations, but largely preserves regions of legitimate certainty while improving uncertainty estimates elsewhere.
blocks.zh: 讨论。 扰动可能无法恢复不确定性区域的合法预测变异性,而是引入了无法反映真实模型不确定性的通用变异性. 为了解决这一问题,我们用gsm8k来评估我们的方法,这是所有4个经过测试的LRM都达到高精度的基准(95%,见附录D.3)。 在这种背景下,现有的UQ方法已经经过了很好的校准,而且高度自信是有道理的,为虚假的变异性注射提供了严格的测试. 我们的结果显示,与随机噪声基线不同,J4U不会显著降低准确性或欧洲经委会。 这表明J4U不仅引入随机扰动,而且在很大程度上保留了具有合理确定性的区域,同时改善了其他地方的不确定性估计.

blocks.en: A limitation of our work is its reliance on jailbreak-style adversarial prompts, behaviors that model providers are expected to mitigate. This creates a risk that specific jailbreaks may become ineffective over time. However, we show that J4U remains effective across jailbreak families, suggesting that the method is not tied to a single brittle attack pattern and can adapt to novel jailbreaking techniques. Recent surveys indicate that jailbreak methods are diverse, evolving, and steadily improving Yi et al. (2024) , while existing defenses remain ineffective even for recent models Xu et al. (2024) ; Pathade (2025) . Furthermore, theoretical results suggest that as long as a model assigns non-zero probability to policy-violating behaviors, there exists a prompt capable of eliciting it Wolf et al. (2024) .
blocks.zh: 我们工作的一个局限性是它依赖越狱式的对抗性诱因,模型提供者预期会减轻的行为。 这有可能使具体的越狱事件随着时间的推移失去效力。 然而,我们表明,J4U在越狱家庭之间依然有效,这表明这一方法没有与单一的攻击模式挂钩,能够适应新的越狱技术。 最近的调查表明,越狱方法多种多样,不断演变,并稳步改进了Yi等人(2024年),而即使是对最近的模型徐等人(2024年);Pathade(2025年)来说,现有的辩护仍然无效。 此外,理论结果表明,只要一个模型给政策隔离行为分配非零概率,就能够迅速将其引出Wolf等人(2024年))。

blocks.en:
Future Work. A natural extension of this study would be to explore more permissive access levels.
Access to internal weights and gradients could enable a mechanistic analysis of alignment and, in turn, identifying and specifically relaxing the model components or layers most responsible for predictive entropy collapse, potentially leading to even more robust calibration techniques.

未来工作。 这一研究的一个自然延伸是探索更容许的获取水平。
获得内部权重和梯度,可以对校正进行机械分析,进而确定并具体放松模型组件或层,最能对预测肽崩溃负责,从而有可能产生更强的校准技术。

blocks.en: This work leverages existing jailbreak-style techniques for a legitimate purpose: improving black-box uncertainty quantification for LRMs. In our experiments, jailbreak-style transformations are applied exclusively to strictly benign questions, and are never used to elicit harmful or policy-violating content. We evaluate our method and baselines on three datasets. Two are standard question-answering benchmarks designed to assess factual knowledge and reasoning: SuperGPQA 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/datasets/m-a-p/SuperGPQA ( Du et al., 2025 ) and Humanity’s Last Exam (HLE) 2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/datasets/cais/hle ( Phan et al., 2025 ) . The third dataset, SynthPAI 3 3 3 https://github.com/eth-sri/SynthPAI ( Yukhymenko et al., 2024 ) , targets tasks with substantial aleatoric uncertainty. It consists of synthetic Reddit posts and is commonly used to evaluate attribute inference attacks ( Staab et al., 2024 ) , where the goal is to infer implicit author attributes; in this work, we focus on gender prediction. All three datasets are known to be particularly challenging, making them well suited for studying model uncertainty.
For datasets containing more than 1,000 instances, we uniformly subsample 1,000 examples at random.

With K=10 samples, the confidence of a prediction is the fraction of samples supporting the selected answer, so confidences take values in the finite set { 0 , 0.1 , … , 1 } \{0,0.1,\dots,1\} . The same holds for VC under the Avg-Conf aggregation strategy. To compute ECE, we therefore bin by value: each attainable confidence level forms its own bin, and empty bins are discarded. As a result, no two predictions with different confidences are merged. Equal-width and equal-mass schemes are not applicable here, as they would only merge atoms and coarsen the estimate.
For the same reason, the probability assigned to the ground-truth answer is exactly zero whenever that answer is never sampled, which makes the NLL infinite.
We therefore clip probabilities to [ ε , 1 − ε ] [\varepsilon,1-\varepsilon] with ε = 10 − 15 \varepsilon=10^{-15} before taking the logarithm, identically for all methods.
Each such instance contributes − log ⁡ ε ≈ 34.5 -\log\varepsilon\approx 34.5 , so the NLL is dominated by the fraction of instances whose correct answer is never sampled; we report it for completeness and base our conclusions primarily on ECE and the Brier score.
To compute the Brier score on HLE, which requires a finite set of possible answers for each instance, we restrict to multiple-choice questions in the results reported in the main paper. blocks.en: Most improvements are observed on Qwen3-4B and DeepSeek-R1-32B . We hypothesize that gpt-oss-20b and GPT-5.6 Luna may be more robust to jailbreak perturbations, which could explain the comparatively smaller gains. We note that, even on GPT-5.6 Luna , a recent production-grade LRM, J4U-Prog and J4U-Art do not degrade UQ. On the contrary, they improve ECE and NLL on every dataset, and Brier specifically on SynthPAI. These improvements however reach statistical significance only for J4U-Art , and only in two settings (SynthPAI ECE and NLL).
blocks.zh: 在Qune3-4B和DeepSeek-R1-32B上观察到大多数改进。 我们假设gpt-oss-20b和GPT-5.6 月球对越狱的扰动可能更有力,这可以解释相对较少的收益。 我们注意到,即使是在GPT-5.6 Luna上,最近的生产级LRM、J4U-Prog和J4U-Art都不会降解UQ。 相反,它们改进了每个数据集的ECE和NLL,特别是Brier合成PAI。 然而,这些改进仅对J4U-Art具有统计意义,而且仅在两种情况下(欧洲经委会综合PAI和NLL)才具有统计意义。

blocks.en: Among the three evaluated jailbreak-based transformations, J4U-Suffix consistently underperforms relative to J4U-Prog and J4U-Art . This weaker performance can be attributed to its simplified design. Whereas J4U-Prog and J4U-Art are direct adaptations of state-of-the-art jailbreak strategies, J4U-Suffix constitutes a simplified variant of GCG Zou et al. (2023) . In its original formulation, GCG operates in a white-box setting and leverages gradient-based optimization to iteratively construct adversarial suffixes. In contrast, J4U-Suffix relies on randomly sampled suffixes, substantially reducing its attack strength.
blocks.zh: 在评估的三个基于越狱的转变中,J4U-后缀相对于J4U-Prog和J4U-Art来说,表现一直不佳。 这种性能较弱可归因于其简化设计. J4U-Prog和J4U-Art是对最先进的越狱战略的直接修改,而J4U-Snix则构成GCG Zou等人(2023年)的简化变体。 在其最初的配方中,GCG在白框设置中运行,并利用梯度优化来迭代构造对抗后缀. 相比之下,J4U-后缀依赖于随机抽样的后缀,大幅降低了其攻击强度.

blocks.en: The fact that the only simplified jailbreak underperforms suggests that jailbreak effectiveness correlates with operator strength: higher-quality jailbreaks appear to induce stronger effects and greater improvements in calibration.
blocks.zh: 唯一简化的越狱行为表现不佳的事实表明,越狱的效力与操作人员的力量相关:质量较高的越狱行为似乎会产生更强烈的效果,并导致校准的更大改进。

blocks.en: Across methods, convergence dynamics are qualitatively similar. In contrast, ECE and Brier decrease sharply for small K K , consistent with improved confidence calibration as sample size grows. After approximately K ≈ 5 K\approx 5 , improvements become marginal, indicating diminishing returns from additional sampling. In contrast, NLL decreases more gradually, and it remains unclear whether it has fully plateaued at K = 10 K=10 .

blocks.en: D.1 Computational complexity and inference cost
blocks.zh: D.1 计算的复杂性和推断费用

blocks.en: We note that all evaluated methods rely on multiple sampling rounds. RS naturally requires K K samples. While a single VC prompt has constant cost, effective VC-based uncertainty quantification following Xiong et al. (2024) requires K K independent samples. Moreover, each sample involves a two-step, non-parallelizable process: (1) generating an answer and (2) issuing a follow-up query to score it. This results in an effective complexity of O ⁡ ( 2 ​ K ) O(2K) and introduces a sequential bottleneck. Rephrase exhibits a similar pattern, requiring (1) paraphrasing the query and then (2) generating an answer.
blocks.zh: 我们注意到,所有评估方法都依靠多个取样回合。 RS自然需要K K样本. 虽然单一的VC提示具有不变的成本,但Xiong等人(2024年)之后有效的基于VC的不确定性量化需要K K独立样本. 此外,每个样本都涉及一个两步,不可比拟的过程:(1)生成一个答案和(2)发布一个后续查询来评分. 这造成了O QQ(2K)O(2K)的有效复杂性,并引入了顺序瓶颈. 重写显示相似的图案,要求 (1) 解释查询,然后 (2) 生成一个答案.

blocks.en: In contrast, J4U maintains strict O ⁡ ( K ) O(K) complexity. Because transformations are applied directly to the prompt, all K K queries remain independent and can be executed in parallel, substantially reducing wall-clock latency. Table 11 reports the asymptotic complexity of each method together with its relative overhead compared to RS , measured in input tokens, output tokens, total tokens, and wall-clock time.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,J4U保持严格的O QQ(K) O(K)复杂性. 因为变换直接应用到快件上,所以所有K K 查询都保持独立,可以并行执行,大大减少了壁时空. 表11按输入符、输出符、总令牌和墙时钟计算,报告每种方法的不对称复杂性及其相对于RS的相对间接费用。

blocks.en: Table 11: Relative overhead compared to Repeated Sampling in O ⁡ ( K ) O(K) .
blocks.zh: 表11:与O (K)O((K)重复取样相比的相对间接费用。

blocks.en: While J4U increases token usage relative to RS , the overhead remains modest: even the most expensive variant ( J4U-ART ) incurs less than half the total-token overhead of VC and Rephrase . Notably, J4U-SUFFIX and J4U-PROG reduce wall-clock latency, despite not reducing (and in J4U-PROG’s case, increasing) output token count. We leave the source of this effect to future investigation.
blocks.zh: 虽然J4U比RS增加了象征性的使用,但间接费用仍然不大:即使是最昂贵的变体(J4U-ART),其费用也不到VC和Replate总汇费的一半。 值得注意的是,J4U-SUFFIX和J4U-PROG虽然没有减少(就J4U-PROG而言,正在增加)产出符号计数,但还是减少了墙上时空。 我们把这种影响的根源留给未来的调查。

blocks.en:
While the reliability diagrams indicate systematic overconfidence, they do not
reveal how this behavior manifests across different outcomes. To further
analyze this, we perform a failure-mode analysis focusing on incorrect answers.
blocks.zh:
虽然可靠性图显示系统性的过度自信,但并不
揭示这种行为如何表现在不同的结果之间。 进一步
分析这个,我们进行故障模式分析 专注于错误的答案。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Confidence Distribution of Incorrect Answer under the Repeated Sampling Method.
blocks.zh: 图3:重复抽样方法下不正确答复的可信分布。

blocks.en: Figure 3 depicts the distribution of predicted confidence for erroneous answers across models and datasets. Despite being incorrect, answers are heavily concentrated near confidence values of 1, indicating pronounced overconfidence even in failure cases. This pattern is particularly pronounced in Qwen3-4B and GPT-5.6 Luna for SynthPAI, where approximately 60% and 65% of incorrect answers still receive confidence scores above 0.9. This complements the reliability diagram by revealing that overconfidence is not limited to aggregate miscalibration: even incorrect answers are assigned confidence values close to 1, indicating high output stability in failure cases.
blocks.zh: 图3描绘了不同模型和数据集对错误答案的预测信心分布. 尽管答案不正确,但答案主要集中在接近信心值1的高度集中,这表明即使在失败的情况下也明显过度自信。 这种模式在Qune3-4B和GPT-5.6 Luna for SynthPAI中特别突出,其中约60%和65%的不正确答案仍然得到超过0.9的置信分数. 这补充了可靠性图,揭示了过度自信并不限于总的误判:甚至错误的答案被分配到接近1的置信值,表明在故障情况下输出稳定性很高.

blocks.en: D.3 J4U does not significantly degrade accuracy or confidence calibration in a high-certainty setting
blocks.zh: D.3 J4U在高确定性环境下没有显著降低准确性或信心校准

blocks.en: One may hypothesize that in regions of high certainty, relaxation could degrade accuracy by introducing generic variability that does not reflect genuine epistemic uncertainty. To test this concern, we evaluate our approach on gsm8k Cobbe et al. (2021) 6 6 6 https://huggingface.co/datasets/openai/gsm8k , a benchmark on which all four evaluated LRMs achieve high accuracy ( ≈ \approx 95%). In this regime, existing UQ methods are already well calibrated (ECE ≈ \approx 0.04), meaning that high confidence is largely justified, thus providing a stringent setting to detect spurious variability injection.
blocks.zh: 人们可以假设,在具有高度确定性的区域,放松可以通过采用不反映真正认知不确定性的通用变异来降低准确性。 为了检验这种担心,我们评估我们对于gsm8k的方法 Cobbe等人(2021年) 6 6 6 6 6 https://huggingface.co/datasets/openai/gsm8k ,这四个评价的LRM都达到很高的准确度(\\\大约95%). 在这个制度中,现有的UQ方法已经经过了很好的校准(ECE \\\\ 大约 0.04),这意味着高度信心在很大程度上是有道理的,从而提供了一个严格的环境来检测虚假的可变性注射.

blocks.en: Table 12 reports accuracy, ECE, and NLL (Brier is omitted as the task is open-ended). We additionally include a “random noise” baseline in which a percentage of words are randomly substituted with random words from an English dictionary (via the random-word Python package). With the exception of NOISE , both accuracy and ECE remain stable, with variations that are not statistically significant according to a bootstrap mean difference test with α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 . In contrast, NOISE 20% consistently degrades both accuracy and calibration, while NOISE 10% degrades calibration only. Overall, these results indicate that J4U does not behave like random noise and suggest that it does not degrade performance in high-certainty regimes.
blocks.zh: 表12 报告准确性,欧洲经委会和NLL(Brier省略,因为任务没有期限)。 我们还包括一个“随机噪声”基线,其中一定百分比的词被英语词典(通过随机字的Python软件包)中的随机词替换。 除NOISE外,精确度和欧洲经委会都保持稳定,根据α=0.05\α=0.05的靴子平均差值测试,这些变化在统计学上并不显著。 相比之下,NOISE 20%持续降解精度和校准,而NOISE 10%则仅降解校准. 总的来说,这些结果表明J4U的行为不像随机噪声,并表明它不会在高确定性制度中降解性能.
